title: Swap Two Variables
question: Read two values and swap them without using a temporary variable.
code:
first = input("First value: ")
second = input("Second value: ")
first, second = second, first
print("First:", first)
print("Second:", second)
expected_output:
For inputs apple and orange:
First value: apple
Second value: orange
First: orange
Second: apple
explanation: Python tuple unpacking assigns the values in the opposite order.
